objective: Expose server-prepared KL private preview and per-media approval inside Profile KL and make save actions show server-confirmed feedback without changing public release.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main baseline 72de1e7. Production S1 chapter 2 has prepared private preview v2 and 4 private media assets with 0/4 server-approved; chapter is draft/unreleased. Installed Android OTA adoption not verified.
chosenApproach: Reuse existing privileged KlAdminPreview server RPCs in the Profile KL studio, synchronize per-media approval status, derive UI indicators from server state, show feedback at action points.
selectionRationale: Small UI-only wiring reuses tested authorization and backend state; no silent mass approval, database writes, native code, duplicate publishing flow, or new backend API.
alternativeApproaches: Automatically mark uploaded media approved when chapter artwork was locally approved (rejected: bypasses per-file review and server security).
Replace current KL publishing UI and schema with a unified publication wizard (rejected: high regression risk and unnecessary redesign).
preserveBehaviors: No public chapter release or schedule change
Scene 1-3 anchors and effects remain independent
No-op saves retain previous preview and approval state
Only verified server RPC response can mark media approved
No Community Wall media rendering, navigation, or backend schema modifications
acceptanceChecks: S1 Ch2 existing prepared preview is reopenable without reuploading media
Individual media approval actions require privileged RPC and status refresh from server
Saved scene anchor/effect feedback is next to the action
No-op scene save does not invalidate prepared preview
Private preview is opened on demand to avoid editor image-memory spikes
Required focused tests, TS check and scope gate must pass before merge
Release separately only after exact runtime-compatible RC and OTA gates
